task: Create a Part::Torus object named 'Torus' in the document at /home/user/Documents/ring.FCStd. Set Radius1=35, Radius2=8, Angle1=-90, Angle2=90, Angle3=180. Set its Label to 'DonutSlice'. Save the file.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with the empty document /home/user/Documents/ring.FCStd. Switch to the Part workbench and use Part > Primitives > Torus (or the Torus toolbar button) to add a new Part::Torus. In the Data tab of the Property panel, change the parameters to these exact values: Radius1=35, Radius2=8, Angle1=-90, Angle2=90, Angle3=180. This creates a half-sweep, half-profile torus slice. Change the object's Label to exactly 'DonutSlice'. Save the file with Ctrl+S so the changes are written back to /home/user/Documents/ring.FCStd.
